title: Aqar.fm Property Scraper
description: Scrape real estate listings from Aqar.fm (Saudi Arabia). Provide a search URL and/or use the supported filters below.

startUrl.title: Aqar.fm Search URL
startUrl.description: Paste any Aqar.fm search or listing URL, e.g. https://sa.aqar.fm/en/apartment-for-rent/riyadh. When set, it takes priority over Property type and Location. Leave empty to build the URL from the filters below.

propertyType.title: Property type
propertyType.description: Used only when no search URL is provided. Supported categories verified against Aqar.fm.

location.title: Location (city)
location.description: City slug such as riyadh, jeddah, dammam, makkah, madinah. Requires a property type when no search URL is provided.

minPrice.title: Minimum price (SAR)
minPrice.description: Only include listings at or above this price.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price (SAR)
maxPrice.description: Only include listings at or below this price.

bedrooms.title: Minimum bedrooms
bedrooms.description: Only include listings with at least this many bedrooms.

bathrooms.title: Minimum bathrooms
bathrooms.description: Only include listings with at least this many bathrooms.

family.title: Family or singles
family.description: Filter listings advertised for families or for singles.

results_wanted.title: Maximum results
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of listings to collect.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy or custom proxies for reliable scraping.
